workload: traced decode T=512, bf16 act / BFP8 weights / HiFi2 / fp32_dest_acc; tt-perf-report 1.2.8 advice-enabled

advice_items.advice: Place matmul input0 in L1 (currently DRAM_INTERLEAVED)
advice_items.evidence: M=512 activation is only 16 M-tiles; L1 height-sharding cannot tile-align across >16 cores (ttnn errors: 'Invalid sharding core_grid' / shard-align TT_FATAL over 8x8 and 8x10). Matmuls already run on 64-80 cores via DRAM-interleaved 2D multicast at 30-42% DRAM util. Block-sharded L1 in0 would add a per-matmul reshard exceeding the benefit for this prefill-shaped (large-M) workload. Prefill guidance (DRAM-interleaved + 2D configs) is the skill-correct mapping for M=512.

advice_items.advice: FF1 output subblock 1x1 is small, try out_subblock_h*out_subblock_w >= 2
advice_items.evidence: FF1 (512x768x2048 + fused erf-gelu) core_grid gives 48.5us; explicit configs with subblock 2x2 (55.9us), 1x4 (54.8us) are all slower; 2x4 errors. core_grid config kept. The 48us includes ~24us inherent gelu SFPU compute.
qkv/dense/ffn kept on core_grid (best measured); ffn_out uses explicit in0_block_w=8, subblock 1x3 which the advice confirms 'look good'.

advice_items.advice: Use HiFi4 with BF16 activations for full accuracy (generic, on every matmul)
advice_items.evidence: Same-dtype (bf16-weight) fidelity comparison: HiFi4 adds +9% traced-decode latency (3.35ms vs HiFi2 3.06ms) for only +0.0008 worst-case PCC. Selected policy (BFP8/HiFi2/fp32_dest_acc) passes >=0.995 on all real-weight tests (worst 0.99674) at 2.95ms. HiFi2 kept.

advice_items.advice: DRAM-sharded decode matmul (skill mandatory when DRAM-bound & not sharded)
advice_items.evidence: DRAM-sharded matmul is the small-M (M=1 autoregressive decode) pattern. This TTS encoder's 'decode' is a full-sequence traced replay (M=seq_len up to 512), i.e. prefill-shaped and compute-balanced (roofline 12.8%, not DRAM-bound). 2D multicast over 64-80 cores is the correct choice; DRAM-sharded (in0 width-sharded L1 on matching grid) requires M=1-style tiny activations.
